Keep Screen On for Bluetooth Scanning

Enabling this feature keeps the screen temporarily awake while the app scans for Bluetooth devices. On Android, BLE scanning is limited or paused when the screen is off, so turning this on ensures accurate device detection. Disabling this feature saves battery, but scanning may be less accurate when the screen is off.

Our app uses Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) to provide its core functionality. Due to Android’s policies, BLE access requires location permission because your location can be inferred from nearby BLE and WiFi signals.

While the app works fine with location access only while you're using it, granting all-time location access ensures uninterrupted BLE scanning, even when the app is running in the background. Without this, the Android system may restrict or block BLE access, which could impact the app’s functionality.

We respect your privacy and only use location access for BLE scanning to make the app work seamlessly. The app does not transmit your data over the internet, and all information is securely stored locally on your device.

Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) is a widely used wireless protocol that powers a huge variety of devices around you — from headphones, smartwatches, and fitness trackers to AirTags, IoT devices, game controllers, and even modern intimate gadgets. BLE devices communicate by broadcasting small packets of data, which can include device identifiers, metadata, and other information necessary for connectivity.

These broadcasts, while essential for device functionality, can also be used to track your presence and movements. For example, a cheap pair of wireless headphones may expose a persistent identifier publicly. Anyone listening to BLE packets nearby — whether governments, companies, or malicious actors — could potentially use that information to track you without your consent.

Fortunately, many modern devices implement privacy features in BLE to prevent tracking, such as randomized addresses and limited advertising. DM BT helps you distinguish between devices that protect your privacy and those that might be trackable. By analyzing BLE traffic in your surroundings, the app gives you insight into which devices are safe to use.

Beyond analysis, DM BT can help protect you in real-time. The app can alert you when a suspicious device is nearby or if a device is moving with you over time, giving you an early warning against potential stalking or unwanted tracking. You can configure alerts based on device identifiers, types, or behaviors to fit your security needs.

By making this app, the goal is to empower you with knowledge and control over the BLE devices in your environment. Understanding which devices are broadcasting trackable information and which are privacy-conscious allows you to make informed decisions about what you use, wear, and interact with daily.
